caller_authority: Tern next-task directive for MP-IMG4 (baseline 669fafca318944066596368e2ca73b37859d1781, implemented on dev on top of 39c5182) under the Caller's resumption instruction and ADR-0014.

profile.debug_note: The debug profile aborts with a main-thread stack overflow on this host regardless of this change (§19.214); native sets use release.

implementation.ownership: ConsumerId + attach/detach on the process-wide ImageUploadService; a frame is evictable only when its consumer set is empty.
implementation.eviction: evict(frame, window) refuses NotRetained, PaintInProgress (paint callback holds the frame), ConsumersRemain, or NotOwnedByWindow, then calls Window::drop_image for every tile, releases a Staged admission or quarantines an in-flight one and asserts transfer termination to free it, removes the frame and prunes idle generation pools.
implementation.window_close: evict_owned_by(window) sweeps every frame the window owns with no consumer and reports evicted/skipped/images/released.
implementation.lazy_recreation: A new device generation creates a pool on first use; evicted or stale frames are re-prepared on demand through the existing prepare path, and the paint path reports PaintStatus::Evicted for an evicted identity.
implementation.counters: evicted_frames, dropped_atlas_images, released_payload_bytes and consumers are added to ImageUploadCounters; retention stays capped at two frames and 32 MiB raster + 32 MiB tile payload.

manifest.shared_identity: shared@1 is prepared once, attached by two consumers, and survives the first detach

sampled_working_set.method: external PowerShell sampler polling Get-Process WorkingSet64 every 150 ms while the process ran
sampled_working_set.note: The last sample is taken while the deliberately retained closing frame still exists immediately before the close sweep; this is a sampled working set, not a sum of declared budgets.
